system.description: The messenger animal has 2 BP and the normal characteristics of its species. It travels without rest or food, speaks the chosen language and carries a spoken message of unlimited length to a location previously visited by the caster. Its base travel limit is 10 km, after which it dissolves. This reminder preserves the instructions and improvements; the GM creates or represents the animal and manages its journey. Since the base duration is special, duration improvements are listed without assigning an arbitrary timed expiry.
system.summary: The mage creates a messenger of flesh and blood, which can deliver its message to a predetermined destination.
